# Leaves over the bed for a second winter

The stepping stones reduced foot traffic and the leaf-covered soil is loose again. Two changes now point in the same direction, so the comparison still cannot isolate one cause. [[Garden notebook]] records a working practice rather than a clean causal result. That is enough for deciding what to do this weekend.
